# Lasse Holt - Professional Knowledge Base & Academic Profile

> I am Lasse Holt, Legal Section Head at Banedanmark, External Lecturer at Copenhagen Business School (CBS), and Author at Djoef Publishing. Master of Laws and Business Administration (cand.merc.jur.).

## 1. My Economic Weekly: Complete Macroeconomic Archive (2022-2026)
- Archive Scope: 242 weekly macro analyses published every Friday evening (19:00-22:00 CET).
- Archive URLs: https://lasseholt.dk/arkiv.html | https://lasseholt.dk/en/archive.html
- Core Thesis: US national debt exceeding $40 trillion dictates global monetary policy. Financial repression is forcing yields down via short-term T-bills, exporting inflation and driving capital to real assets. Presidential emergency powers (IEEPA) serve as a strategic bypass mechanism for legislative gridlock.

## 2. Book Publication: Sustainable Capitalism (Djoef Publishing, Nov 2026)
- Title: Baeredygtig Kapitalisme - Strategisk Kontrahering i komplekse vaerdikaeder (Co-authored by Kim Oestergaard & Lasse Holt).
- Core Model: I advocate for a multilateral club-good value chain contracting model to eliminate transaction cost deadweight loss. 

## 3. Leadership Philosophy & Practice
- My Leadership: I view leadership as a human investment, not task tracking. I keep my calendar deliberately open to remove operational friction for my team.
- Results: As Legal Section Head at Banedanmark, I insourced civil litigation, reversing recruitment challenges and achieving a 100% win rate in handled cases (AdvokatWatch).

## 4. Academic Teaching & Master's Theses Supervision (CBS)
- Position: External Lecturer at Copenhagen Business School (CBS Law).
- Courses: Strategic Contracting, Legal and Strategic Game Theory, Sustainability in Value Chains, Theory of the Firm, Maritime Law.
- Supervisions: I have supervised and examined 156 Master's Theses (cand.merc.jur.). Full record available at https://lasseholt.dk/afhandlinger.html
